**Finding: deviation (critical) — §12, p0077**

The Agreement's only liability limitation caps TrueLink alone (and only for §§3, 4, 7 and 11), leaving Client's liability — including the very broad §12a indemnity — completely uncapped. That is walk-away territory under LOL-CAP, and there is no consequential-damages exclusion or mutual carve-out set.

Redline (validated, ok:true): the existing sentence is edited in place to (i) make the cap mutual and Agreement-wide at the greater of 12 months' hosting/support compensation and USD 1,000,000, (ii) place indemnification, confidentiality/data-protection/security breaches, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement outside the cap for both parties, and (iii) confirm Client's payment obligations are not capped damages.
